messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
అతను నా మీదకు వస్తున్నాడని కనిపించింది తల ఎత్తుగా మరియు ఆకలితో నిండినట్లుగా, అలా గాలి అతనితో కంపిస్తున్నట్లు కనిపించింది.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Questi | demonstrative pronoun, “this one / he” | అతను | “he” | OK | | parea | “seemed” (perceptual verb) | కనిపించింది | “seemed / appeared” | OK | | che (1) | complementizer introducing clause | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | contra | preposition “against, opposite to” | **నా మీదకు** | “to my (against me)” | GRAMMAR (should be “నా మీద” for natural Telugu) | | me | 1st‑person pronoun, object of “against” | నా | “my / me” | OK | | venisse | subjunctive “to be coming” | **వస్తున్నాడని** | “that he is coming” | OK | | con (1) | preposition “with” (introducing first attribute) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | la | definite article “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | test' | noun “head” | తల | “head” | OK | | alta | adjective “high, raised” (describing head) | ఎత్తుగా | “highly / raised” | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | మరియు | “and” | OK | | con (2) | preposition “with” (introducing second attribute) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | rabbiosa | adjective “ravenous, fierce” (modifying hunger) | ఆకలితో | “with hunger” (carries the sense of intensity) | OK | | fame | noun “hunger” | నిండినట్లుగా | “as if filled (with hunger)” | OK | | sì | resultative adverb “so, thus” | **అలా** | “so / thus” | OK | | che (2) | complementizer for result clause | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | parea (2) | “seemed” (in result clause) | కనిపించింది | “seemed / appeared” | OK | | che (3) | complementizer for innermost clause | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | l'aere | noun “air” | గాలి | “air” | OK | | ne | clitic pronoun “of it / because of him” (causal) | **అతనితో** | “with him / because of him” | OK | | tremesse | subjunctive “trembled” | కంపిస్తున్నట్లు | “as if trembling” | OK |
### Items Flagged
- **GRAMMAR**: *contra* → “నా మీదకు”. In natural Telugu the locative/ablative “నా మీద” (or “నా వైపు”) would be preferred; the added “కు” creates a non‑standard case ending. - **UNNECESSARY**: All occurrences of the complementizer “che”, the article “la”, and the preposition “con” (both instances) do not have direct equivalents in Telugu and are therefore omitted.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 46: - Original: అతను నా మీదకు వస్తున్నాడని కనిపించింది - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – “నా మీదకు” is non‑standard; should be “నా మీద”. - Corrected: అతను నా మీద వస్తున్నాడని కనిపించింది
- Line 47: - Original: తల ఎత్తుగా మరియు ఆకలితో నిండినట్లుగా, - Issue: **WRONG** – “నిండినట్లుగా” adds meaning not present in the source; the phrase should simply convey “with ravenous hunger”. - Corrected: తల ఎత్తుగా, ఆకలితో,
- Line 48: - Original: అలాగే గాలి అతనితో కంపిస్తున్నట్లు కనిపించింది. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
